headline: BAJAJFINSV delivered strong performance across segments, with BAGIC and BALIC showing resilience despite industry pressures.

segments.BAGIC: BAGIC's combined ratio improved to 101.1% from 102.9%, moving down from the previous quarter and excluding one-time impacts, COR stood at 100.2%. GWP growth was 6% excluding volatile businesses.
segments.BALIC: BALIC saw VNB margin improve significantly with a 59% increase to INR405 crores, and NBM up to 19%. Renewal premium grew by 24%, leading to GWP growth of 16%.

keyThemes: Solvency ratios remain strong at over 300% for both insurance subsidiaries.
Focus on sustainable and profitable growth in BALIC with changes in product mix and distribution arrangements.
Robust performance from BFL, with AUM up by 26%, net income up by 26%, and ROE of 19.08%.
Long-term commitment to maintaining disciplined underwriting and risk selection across all segments.
